convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA, iRSI) with simple crossover entry logic, fixed lot sizing with optional martingale on loss, and straightforward SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries. The martingale component is simple (multiply by 2 on loss) and does not depend on margin, so it remains auto-convertible.

derived_values.name: Martingale lot size on consecutive losses

other_exits: None - EA relies solely on SL/TP for exit; no signal-based early close

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Base lot size is Lots input (default 0.1). On each consecutive loss, lot size doubles (Lots * 2^consecutive_losses). On a win, lot size resets to base Lots. Capped at MaxLots.

custom_logic_notes: Martingale recovery system: after a losing trade closes (detected via deal history in OnTick), the next trade lot size is doubled. After a winning trade closes, the lot resets to the base Lots value. Consecutive losses compound the multiplier (2x, 4x, 8x...). The EMA crossover uses previous bar values ([1] and [2]) to confirm the crossover has actually occurred on the completed bar, not a transient cross on the current forming bar. RSI filter uses previous bar value ([1]) compared to level 50.
python_conversion_notes: 1. Digit adjustment: SL and TP input values are in 'pips' (2/4 digit style). Must multiply by 10 when symbol has 5 or 3 digits (typical _Point<0.001 check). 2. Martingale: Track consecutive losses via trade history. Each loss doubles lots; each win resets to base. Must implement deal scanning equivalent to HistoryDealSelect. 3. New bar detection: Implement IsNewBar() using static datetime comparison of Time[0]. 4. EMA crossover: Use previous completed bar values (shift=1 and shift=2) for crossover confirmation, not current bar (shift=0). 5. RSI filter: Also uses previous bar (shift=1). 6. Position check: Only one position at a time - check total open positions before entry. 7. Market order execution with FOK fill and deviation=1 slippage tolerance.
